exposure: Indices of insulin secretion (HOMA2-B) and sensitivity (HOMA2-S)
Pathophysiological subtypes of gestational diabetes mellitus (insulin-resistant GDM, insulin-insufficient GDM, both, or neither)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1308 pregnant women with one or more risk factors for GDM who underwent a 75g OGTT.
finding: Precision categorization of GDM using HOMA2-S and HOMA2-B does not provide useful diagnostic or prognostic information for most pregnancy outcomes, but it did identify a novel subgroup of GDM patients characterized by an isolated postprandial defect in insulin sensitivity.
cross-section timing: Measurements for GDM diagnosis and subtyping were performed during pregnancy at the time of the 75g OGTT.
